firm_or_style: prop (Trillium), discretionary intraday, capitulation/reversal and breakout specialist
setup_name: Right side of the V (capitulation reversal long)
universe_filter: stocks with an outsized fast decline vs the index and vs their own driver (e.g. >20% in ~5 straight down days), in play, heavy volume / high float turnover
conditions: stock dropped far in a short time (multi-day straight-line selloff, e.g. Tesla -24% in 5 days, MSTR -50% in 4 days)
decline is larger than the index or underlying driver move
intraday selloff with volume expansion / flush (capitulation), not a steady slope without volume
confluence turn signal such as related names halting limit-up or market bouncing
entry_trigger: first break above the prior 2-minute bar high after the flush (alternatives: break of a moving average or downtrend line)
stop: below the low of the V (the flush low)
target_or_exit: not specified; hold the bounce, exit on loss of prior bar lows
management: add on higher-low pullbacks; size up exponentially when the setup grades A/A+
stated_edge: waiting for the turn gives a defined stop and with-trend probability; avoids death by a thousand cuts from buying the falling knife
data_needed: 2-min bars (MCF has 5-min), halt data, float turnover
mcf_translation: universe: 5-day return <= -20% and below-index by >10 pts; intraday: after a new session low with 5-min volume >= 3x avg, go long on break of prior 5-min bar high; stop = session low; exit when a 5-min bar closes below prior bar low or at close

mcf_translation: detect N-bar range on 5-min bars (e.g. 6+ bars within 1 ATR), long on close above range high; stop prior bar low; target range height; skip entries more than X bars after the first break
